title: Mediado says unauthorized access to client NTT Solmare's Comic Seemore e-book store disrupted its dealings with the store
date_note: Mediado's notice is dated 25 November and gives no earlier day for its own disclosure; the notice says the intrusion at NTT Solmare was found in October 2026.
geo_basis: The pages read name no city; country centre of Japan
summary: In a notice dated 25 November, e-book distributor Mediado said its client NTT Solmare suffered unauthorized third-party access to its Comic Seemore e-book store, discovered in October 2026, and described the effect on Mediado's business. The Rocket Boys article says Mediado states that unauthorized access to its own systems has not been confirmed and that transactions with the store have resumed.
plain: Mediado, an e-book distributor, says its client's Comic Seemore store was accessed without authorization. Rocket Boys reports Mediado says access to its own systems has not been confirmed and dealings have resumed.
exec: A distributor's business was affected by an outage at a client's store after unauthorized access there; Rocket Boys reports Mediado says access to its own systems has not been confirmed.

sources.name: Mediado: notice on the impact of the suspension at a business partner

validation.note: Mediado's own notice (primary) states the unauthorized access at NTT Solmare; Rocket Boys relays Mediado's statement on its own systems. NTT Solmare's release was not read.

review.note: stronger than source: 'not accessed' changed to 'has not confirmed' access to own systems
